curated_quotes.improvement: Proper collection of waste and management

curated_quotes.problem: Actually once when the waste gets collected public thinks that they have got the permit to throw it randomly at any place.
curated_quotes.improvement: Public should realise the Importance of waste management. Not as a heavy task on them as Govt lay Heavy taxes but as a responsibility To live in a clean and playful Environment. which Will not only benefit them but the others too

curated_quotes.problem: Overfilling dustbin, strong smell, not collecting waste at proper way
curated_quotes.improvement: Better municipal collection and public discipline.

curated_quotes.problem: The common waste management problems in Housing Board Colony, Palakollu, include: Irregular Garbage Collection: Inconsistent municipal collection schedules leading to waste accumulation. Open Waste Dumping: Overflowing public bins and roadside dumping creating unhygienic surroundings and foul odors. Poor Segregation: Lack of proper separation between wet (biodegradable) and dry (plastic/non-biodegradable) waste at the household level. Clogged Drainage Systems: Plastic bags and uncollected rubbish clogging open drains, causing waterlogging during rain.
curated_quotes.improvement: I would like to see strictly daily door-to-door waste collection and more public segregated trash bins for wet, dry, and recyclable waste.

curated_quotes.problem: Lack of awareness of how to minimize those things.
curated_quotes.improvement: Better municipal collection and public discipline.

curated_quotes.problem: “Improper waste segregation and irregular garbage collection are the biggest waste management problems in my area.”
curated_quotes.improvement: I would like to see regular garbage collection proper waste segregation more cycling facilities better cleanliness in the area
stricter source segregation, reliable door-to-door collection, and expanded local recycling facilities.

curated_quotes.problem: No proper waste partition . Most of the dry waste is recyclable but it isn't being recycled or refused .
curated_quotes.improvement: Solve the problem I told above

curated_quotes.problem: Not a separate plastic waste collector
People are not encouraged to keep their waste segregated and nor is it collected separately. Less recycling options nearby
curated_quotes.improvement: More recycling options, eg. people from recycling companies come to societies come and collect the goods twice a month, and more importantly waste collectors should strictly accept segregated waste.

curated_quotes.problem: Improper disposal of waste and littering in public places.
curated_quotes.improvement: I would like regular waste collection, more dustbins, and proper segregation of wet and dry waste.
